# Suzu Sensei

> Online Japanese language school run by Suzu, a certified native Japanese teacher. One-on-one lessons over Zoom for adult learners worldwide, from complete beginners to advanced JLPT candidates.

Suzu Sensei offers private, one-on-one online Japanese lessons for foreigners of any level, taught live over Zoom by a certified native teacher with 8+ years of experience and 600+ students. Every new student starts with a free trial lesson (no card required).

## Services
- Conversation lessons for everyday fluency
- JLPT exam preparation (N5 through N1)
- Beginner course for complete beginners (no prior Japanese knowledge needed)
- Japan trip preparation (travel-focused Japanese)
- Group classes

## Plans
- Ebi Plan — ¥29,000/month, 1 lesson/week (50 min)
- Kani Plan — ¥58,000/month, 2 lessons/week (50 min each)
- Uni Plan — ¥85,000/month, 3 lessons/week (50 min each)

All plans include homework, access to study materials, and a 25-minute counseling session. Payment is handled securely via Stripe.

## Audience
Lessons are held online worldwide across all time zones, with particular focus on learners in the Gulf/Arabian Peninsula (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman) as well as North America, Europe, and elsewhere.
